ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, footer text — the dominant non-background color in the system

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary/muted text, link text, subdued borders, placeholder labels — recedes so body copy reads first

fog.$description: Fog — Card and component borders, subtle dividers, icon outlines at rest — the default hairline

ash.$description: Ash — Dividers between sections, secondary surface tint, input borders in resting state

mist.$description: Mist — Card surfaces, subtle elevated panels, button hover wash, input backgrounds

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, nav background, inverted button text, heading reverse-color treatments

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary action button fill and border, nav top-strip emphasis — the only dark surface, reserved for CTAs

graphite.$description: Graphite — Nav link text color, slightly lifted from #151619 for a softer navigation feel

pewter.$description: Pewter — Outlined button border at rest, ghost control stroke

signal-green.$description: Signal Green — Brand logo accent stroke, brand identity marker — vivid green checkmark against monochrome

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Brand accent — the gradient highlight on hero keywords; also product UI project bars and chart accents

sf-pro-display.$description: Headlines and display — used at 80px/700 for the hero, 48–64px/600–700 for section titles, 24–40px/500–600 for subheadings. Weight 700 at extreme size is the signature: massive bold sans against empty white space carries all the visual weight that color would on other sites.

sf-pro-text.$description: Body, UI labels, buttons, nav links, card content, form fields — the workhorse at 16px/400 for paragraphs, 14px/500 for metadata and labels, 18–20px/600 for emphasized body. The 1.5 line-height at 16px is the default rhythm; tighter 1.2 only appears on compact UI rows.
